claim: An endpoint policy is a JSON policy document in the IAM policy language and must contain a Principal element.
question: What must an endpoint policy contain?

values.display: must contain a Principal element
JSON policy document

evidence.quote: An endpoint policy is a JSON policy document that uses the IAM policy language. It must contain a [Principal](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_principal.html) element.

claim: When you create an interface or gateway endpoint for an AWS service you can attach a single endpoint policy, update it at any time, and if you attach none, AWS attaches the default endpoint policy.
question: What policy does an endpoint get if you attach none?

values.display: attach a single endpoint policy to the endpoint
we attach the default endpoint policy

evidence.quote: When you create an interface or gateway endpoint for an AWS service, you can attach a single endpoint policy to the endpoint. You can update the endpoint policy at any time. If you don't attach an endpoint policy, we attach the default endpoint policy.

claim: The default endpoint policy grants full access to the endpoint.
question: How much access does the default endpoint policy grant?

values.display: grants full access to the endpoint

evidence.quote: The default endpoint policy grants full access to the endpoint.

claim: Not all AWS services support endpoint policies, and if an AWS service does not support them, full access is allowed to any endpoint for that service.
question: What happens if an AWS service does not support endpoint policies?

values.display: Not all AWS services support endpoint policies
we allow full access to any endpoint for the service

evidence.quote: Not all AWS services support endpoint policies. If an AWS service doesn't support endpoint policies, we allow full access to any endpoint for the service.

claim: When you create a VPC endpoint for an endpoint service other than an AWS service, full access is allowed to the endpoint.
question: Does an endpoint policy restrict an endpoint to a non-AWS endpoint service?

values.display: other than an AWS service, we allow full access

evidence.quote: When you create a VPC endpoint for an endpoint service other than an AWS service, we allow full access to the endpoint.

claim: An endpoint policy does not override or replace identity-based or resource-based policies; for example, with an interface endpoint to Amazon S3 you can still use S3 bucket policies to control access from specific endpoints or VPCs.
question: Does an endpoint policy replace IAM or bucket policies?

values.display: does not override or replace identity-based policies or resource-based policies

evidence.quote: An endpoint policy does not override or replace identity-based policies or resource-based policies. For example, if you're using an interface endpoint to connect to Amazon S3, you can also use Amazon S3 bucket policies to control access to buckets from specific endpoints or specific VPCs.

claim: With gateway endpoints the Principal element of the endpoint policy must be set to *, and you specify a principal with the aws:PrincipalArn condition key.
question: How do you limit a gateway endpoint policy to one principal?

values.display: Principal element must be set to
aws:PrincipalArn

evidence.quote: With gateway endpoints, the `Principal` element must be set to `*`. To specify a principal, use the `aws:PrincipalArn` condition key.

claim: After you update an endpoint policy it can take a few minutes for the changes to take effect.
question: How quickly does an endpoint policy change take effect?

values.display: it can take a few minutes

evidence.quote: After you update an endpoint policy, it can take a few minutes for the changes to take effect.

claim: A Gateway Load Balancer endpoint uses only one Availability Zone in the consumer VPC and its subnet cannot be changed later; to use a different subnet you must create a new Gateway Load Balancer endpoint.
question: Can you move a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint to another subnet?

values.display: choose only one Availability Zone in the service consumer VPC
You can't change this subnet later on

evidence.quote: You can choose only one Availability Zone in the service consumer VPC. You can't change this subnet later on. To use a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint in a different subnet, you must create a new Gateway Load Balancer endpoint.

claim: You can create a single Gateway Load Balancer endpoint per Availability Zone per service, and you must select an Availability Zone that the Gateway Load Balancer supports.
question: How many Gateway Load Balancer endpoints can you create per Availability Zone for one service?

values.display: single Gateway Load Balancer endpoint per Availability Zone per service

evidence.quote: You can create a single Gateway Load Balancer endpoint per Availability Zone per service, and you must select the Availability Zone that the Gateway Load Balancer supports.

claim: A Gateway Load Balancer endpoint service cannot initiate requests to resources in your VPC through the endpoint, which only returns responses to traffic that resources in your VPC initiated; the provider must accept the connection request first.
question: Can a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint service start traffic into the consumer VPC?

values.display: can't initiate requests to resources in your VPC
only returns responses to traffic that was initiated

evidence.quote: Before you can use the endpoint service the service provider must accept the connection requests. The service can't initiate requests to resources in your VPC through the VPC endpoint. The endpoint only returns responses to traffic that was initiated by resources in your VPC.

claim: You specify a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint as a route table target by its ID, and when it is the target you cannot specify a prefix list as the destination.
question: Can a route to a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint use a prefix list destination?

values.display: you cannot specify a prefix list as a destination
specify the Gateway Load Balancer endpoint as a target in your route tables

evidence.quote: To route traffic to the endpoint service, specify the Gateway Load Balancer endpoint as a target in your route tables, using its ID. For the diagram above, add routes to the route tables as follows. When using a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint as a target, you cannot specify a prefix list as a destination.

claim: You cannot disassociate a load balancer from an endpoint service while endpoints are connected to the service.
question: Can a provider remove the load balancer of an endpoint service that has connected endpoints?

values.display: can't disassociate a load balancer if there are endpoints connected

evidence.quote: You can't disassociate a load balancer if there are endpoints connected to your endpoint service.
